'''Servant Eleven''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was an [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], the most trusted servants of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], alongside her colleagues. On [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], she worked with the [[Emperor's Wrath]] in order to [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|protect]] [[Darth Vowrawn]] from [[Darth Baras]]' assassins.<ref name="TOR" />
